name: Perplexity (perplexity.ai)
siteVersion: NextAuth SPA (sitemap partitions reference internal web app codename 'comet'); exact build pins not obtainable (HTML shell Cloudflare-challenged) — record on first live capture
description: Capability package for Perplexity's AI search chat at https://www.perplexity.ai. Probe-verified (2026-09-16): Next.js + NextAuth stack; Live NextAuth route group (providers apple/email/google/googleonetap/pplx-jwt-to-cookie/workos, /api/auth/csrf, /api/auth/session, /api/auth/callback/email); session cookie __Secure-next-auth.session-token (matches catalog perplexity-web entry). Chat/search/model surfaces (POST /api/chat, /socket.io/, /rest/chat, /api/config, /api/perplexity/model, /api/search, /api/models) and the HTML shell are behind Cloudflare managed challenge — NO JS bundles obtainable statically, so streaming mechanism, focus modes and model ids are NOT fabricated here and are marked to be verified on first live capture.
author: ui2api capabilities

capabilities.name: Chat / Ask stream
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the Ask composer; streamed answer + citations read off the page. Playwright/CDP UI path: type into composer, keyEnter, read answer until stable. Wire transport behind the composer is unobservable statically (Cloudflare wall) and is driven by the site's own JS — no wire reconstruction needed for the UI path.
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)

verified.cookie: __Secure-next-auth.session-token (NextAuth default on HTTPS; matches provider-catalog perplexity-web entry)

notVerified.streaming: Socket.IO vs SSE vs fetch route handlers — no bundle access; community docs (unverified) describe Engine.IO/Socket.IO with a perplexity_asks JSON event carrying query/search_focus/model
notVerified.focusModes: search_focus values (web/math/video/social/file/science) community-documented only, NOT bundle-verified — perplexity_search focus capability NOT added
notVerified.antiBot: expect cf_clearance / cf_chl_* cookies and possible re-challenge inside a real browser session
